title: Maximum Product of Three Numbers
goal: Find the greatest product obtainable from three different array positions.
strategy: Keep only the extremes that can participate in an optimal triple; a pair of negative values can turn positive.

phasePurposes.inspect: Keep only the extremes that can participate in an optimal triple; a pair of negative values can turn positive.
phasePurposes.update: The winner includes either the three largest values or two negative values and the largest positive value.
phasePurposes.done: The winner includes either the three largest values or two negative values and the largest positive value.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
